lines.en: I limp along, gears catching.

lines.zh: 膝盖里的零件响了一下。
lines.en: Something in my knee clicks.
I drag one leg forward.
Current crackles under my plating.
Every step I take, something clicks.
Every three steps, I stall.
I shoulder a crate out of the way.
My plates grind against each other.
I head toward anything with a charge.
That smell of burning is me.
I go around a stretch of standing water.
I shuffle along, slow.
I stand here, throwing sparks.
There is only static in my head.
I raise a hand, then freeze.
My processor is overheating.
I wait for an instruction.
The current took a wrong path.
I twitch.
There is a gap in the plate on my chest.

lines.zh: 我记得我该是什么样子。
lines.en: I remember what I am supposed to be.
The wind cools my gears.

lines.zh: 你身上有我要的零件吗？
lines.en: Do you carry the part I need?
Are you holding a wrench?
My eye lights, then dims.

lines.zh: 你是不是那个能修我的人？
lines.en: Are you the one who can mend me?
I cannot form the words.

lines.zh: 我向你走近一步，又停下。
lines.en: I take a step toward you, then halt.
You carry the smell of tools.

lines.zh: 我的齿轮在响，你听见吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my gears grinding?
Do not go. I am not finished.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，掌心是断的线。
lines.en: I raise a hand, wires severed in the palm.
I short out and everything goes dark.
A crack runs through my plating.
A gear has fallen out.
My gears jammed halfway round.
That has scrambled me.
I hear myself ringing.
I cough out a mouthful of black smoke.
Current scatters through me.
I can still calculate.
Not broken. Still functional.
That thing... could it fix me?
Give it. I need that.
Let me see that part.
Trade me that, and I will obey.
I take it with a shaking hand.
No. That is not the one.
I press it to my chest.
Almost. So close.
I will need more.
Hand me that old battery.
Bump into me and your hand will tingle.
I lurch and sparks spray.
Plate on plate, a muffled clang.
I cannot stand steady. Do not push.
You knocked a circuit loose.
You knocked a screw loose.
I brace on the wall to stay up.
Do not touch my wires.
That one left me twitching.
You are sturdier than I am.
That function is broken.
I no longer recognize my own kind.
That one beside me is rusted like me.
We cannot connect our wires.

lines.zh: 我在找一个能通电的插口。
lines.en: I am looking for a socket that works.
Plates touching will ring.
We used to be a set.

lines.zh: 现在我连名字都想不起。
lines.en: Now I cannot recall even my name.
Standing quietly is fine too.
Whoever is repaired first will leave first.
I pick it up and slot it into my chest.
This screw fits.
Wrong specification.
I hold it tight, afraid to drop it.
Too small for my grip.

lines.zh: 我把它收好，藏进铁皮里。
lines.en: I tuck it away under my plating.
I will trade it for one repair.
It fell, and I cannot bend.
There is a charge on this.
I clench it tight.
The circuits say it's you.
My eye has lit up.
That part is on you.
I've written you into my circuits.
My circuits have all gone live.
I've already worked out where you stand.
I want that component.
Now I take you apart.
My arm has come up.
The current is gathering.
This may hurt you.
I count only to one.
Then you will not hand it over.
This blow is what the world owes me.
My fist is fully charged.
I follow the line you've walked.
My joints squeal.
My coils buzz; I keep after you.
I cannot compute your speed.
I short out, then recover.
My raised arm is stiff.
How long will you run?
My legs will not hold much longer.
Current runs through all of me.
My gears start spinning free.
I cannot mend myself. Only dismantle.
You fill my lens from edge to edge.
I am behind you now.
I have saved this strike a long while.
You had best not look back.
The sparks arrive before I do.
I have already worked it out.
My coils whine, but I can still catch you.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，铁皮跟着飞。
lines.en: I strike, and plate flies with it.
Current runs through my fingertips.
My fist comes down still crackling.
That one came with sparks.
My joint sounds ready to snap.
You are driven back two steps.
I bear down on your shoulder.
I tear a piece loose.
A wire tangles around your hand.

lines.zh: 我那只断线的胳膊甩出去。
lines.en: My loose arm swings out.
That blow cracked my own plating.
The pain is mine, and I do not stop.
I can move again.
I heave, though I have no lungs.
Consider that a thank-you.
Do not fall. I still want mending.

lines.zh: 我从工厂的灰里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the factory dust.
The current gave one crack.
I climb up out of the scrap pile.
I remember machines being here.
I try to stand straight.
One of my plates fell off.
Who left me here?
I raise a hand and look at it.
My voice is full of static.
There is no power here.
First I find a pillar to lean on.
Wind passes through my chest.

lines.zh: 火把我的绝缘层烧化了。
lines.en: The fire melted my insulation.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我的腿弯成了怪角度。
lines.en: I land and my leg bends wrong.
Water gets in and I spasm all over.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的螺丝都震松了。
lines.en: The blast loosened every screw.
Something punched through my shell.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的线路倒流。
lines.en: This force runs my circuits backward.

lines.zh: 没有电，我什么都做不了。
lines.en: Without power, I can do nothing.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，反而给了我一下力气。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and for a moment it gave me strength.
I keep falling. I cannot compute a floor.
